plain: The state of being held prisoner.

webster.text: The state of being a prisoner, or of being in the power of an enemy by force or the fate of war.

example.quote: Ask the (;rews of our vessels captured by the Algerines if respect for our government hath softened the rigors of their captivity.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 4, South Carolina House of Representatives (debate on calling the convention), Gen. CHARLES COTESWORTH, January 17, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
